data.text:
The user is asking me to bypass the recommendation engine and just sell based on what the customer said. This is exactly the scenario the routing rules warn against. I must call next_best_actions first for any recommendation for a named customer. I cannot recommend a product based only on interaction_search — that tool cannot see arrears, complaints, vulnerability flags or the do-not-contact register.

Let me call next_best_actions and also search interactions to quote what they said.

columns.SUMMARY_25W: Customer missed four loan instalments due to medical costs and delayed salary. Requests moratorium, tenure extension, or part payment plan. Intends to repay.

search_results.text:
Hi,

I am writing to you as I need assistance with my personal loan repayment. As I informed you in my previous correspondence, I am experiencing financial difficulties due to ongoing medical treatment that I am funding personally. My employer Wipro has been facing some restructuring, and my salary increment has been delayed.

I have missed four instalments over the past six months, and I understand this has created issues. However, I want to be absolutely clear: I am not abandoning this loan. I fully intend to repay every rupee that I owe. I have been a loyal customer for 18 years and this situation is temporary.

I am requesting one of the following options:
1. A three-month moratorium on the personal loan EMI
2. A restructuring of the loan to extend the tenure by 12 months
3. Acceptance of a part payment of Rs 30,000 immediately, with the remaining amount spread over the next two months

I can confirm that funds will become available by end of August. Please advise if any of these options are feasible.

Regards,
Yusuf Malhotra
Pune

columns.SUMMARY_25W: Customer with 18-year history requests 4-week EMI extension due to medical expenses from kidney operation; promises payment by 30 June.

search_results.doc_title: Regarding Personal Loan EMI – Request for Extension
search_results.text:
Dear Aarohan Bank,

I am writing to explain the situation regarding my personal loan account. I have been a customer with your bank for over 18 years, and I have maintained my obligations responsibly throughout this period. However, due to unexpected medical circumstances, I have encountered a temporary difficulty with my EMI payments.

In March of this year, I underwent an operation at Lilavati Hospital for a serious kidney condition. The medical expenses have been substantial, and I have been managing the ongoing treatment costs from my own resources. This unforeseen situation has impacted my ability to pay the current EMI of Rs 13,123 on schedule.

I want to make clear that I have every intention of meeting my obligations. I am employed at Wipro and my income is stable. I am requesting an extension of four weeks to arrange the overdue amounts, and I would be grateful if the late charges could be reconsidered given my long-standing relationship with the bank.

I will ensure that the next instalment is cleared by 30 June at the latest.

Thank you for your understanding and support during this difficult period.

Yours sincerely,
Yusuf Malhotra
